avoid: Extended entries (price well above EMA-20 at entry) -- CONFIRMED LOSER, thesis RESOLVED by AMZN (entered Aug 4 at +15.2% above EMA20, stopped -6.57% Aug 17) and META (Jul 15 ~8.5% ext, stopped -8.04% Jul 23). Surviving extended admits are fine now (MSFT +2.45%, QQQ the exception still RED at -2.49%/1.83% cushion, CRM the +38% exception) but that does not vindicate the entry. Firm rule stands: treat >~6-8% above-EMA extension as size-DOWN or wait-for-pullback; when it co-occurs with a shallow cross, SKIP. MSTR correctly SKIPPED 9/1 on +17.2% extension among three stacked flags.

STACKED-FLAG entries (shallow cross + extended above EMA + thin liquidity together) -- SKIP, not size-down: PDBC (0.15% cross + ~6% ext + thin liq, Jul 24) stopped -2.40%. One flag -> size down; two or more stacked -> skip. Applied correctly repeatedly: SLV skipped Aug 28 (two flags), MSTR skipped Sep 1 (three flags: +17.2% ext, 5.8% ATR crypto-proxy vol, 624k thin liq).

Noise-level / opening-bar-artifact crosses -- EQT skipped Aug 28: completed-bar EMA20/60 spread only 0.0145%, far below the 0.1% shallow-cross floor; a live 0.19% read was a 917-share opening-bar artifact on a partial daily bar. Hold the 0.1% floor against thin-liquidity fake-outs.
